overview: This 436-page file combines late-1949 correspondence on Japan’s postwar politics, local government, peace treaty debate, and occupation work with Joint Army–Air weekly intelligence reports from April through December. The reports track Japanese labor and repatriation, Korean military developments, Philippine elections and insurgency, and affairs in Okinawa and the western Pacific.
interest: Its continuous weekly reports reveal how U.S. officials assessed regional tensions before the Korean War, alongside detailed local-government observations.
